newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil shares trim gains, end modestly up.
newsitem.headline: Brazil shares trim gains, end modestly up.

text.p: Brazilian shares trimmed early gains to end modestly up Friday as investors took some profits after yesterday's sharp rise in the telecommunications sector, brokers said.
The Bovespa index, comprising the 48 most active stocks, ended up 0.52 percent at 10,491 points. Volume was a heavy 721.2 million reais ($680.3 million).
Benchmark Telebras, which climbed on rumors of high premiums on the Band B sell-off and higher earnings forecasts, rose 0.9 percent, closing at 133 reais.
State oil firm Petrobras closed off 1.9 percent at 228.51 reais.
Mining giant CVRD, now in private hands, lost 0.7 percent, ending at 25.60 reais.
State power holding Eletrobras closed off 0.3 percent at 502 reais.
